params.headline: Private Label Supplements Design
params.subhead: Whether you already have a brand and want our designers to bring it to life, or you have artwork ready to submit yourself, we have a path for you.

params.content:
Two paths to professionally branded private label supplements.

Design is often the difference between a supplement that gets picked up and one that sits on the shelf. Our team has spent years designing for the supplement industry and understands what works at retail, online, and in practitioner offices.

Choose the path that matches where you are in your branding journey. Both options give you supplement labels that meet FDA requirements, hold up under wear, and represent your brand the way you want it represented.

cards.content:
Our in-house designers will build your brand identity, design your labels, and produce print-ready artwork. Best for brands that need design support, want to launch quickly, or want to choose from our professional pre-made templates.

WORK WITH OUR TEAM →
cards.title: Work with our design team

cards.content:
Already have a brand and a designer? Submit your own artwork using our spec guidelines. Best for established brands or anyone already working with an outside design partner who knows supplement label requirements.

VIEW ART GUIDELINES →
cards.title: Submit customer-supplied art

params.section_subhead: Pick the option that fits your team and timeline. Not sure which is right for you? Talk to a sales consultant and we will walk you through it.

params.content: Every label we produce meets FDA dietary supplement labeling rules. Every label is built on substrates and adhesives proven in the supplement industry. Every label is reviewed for print accuracy before it hits the production line. The goal is not just a good-looking product. The goal is a product that protects you legally and represents you well from the first shipment to the thousandth.
params.headline: Labels that meet FDA requirements, look great, and hold up.

params.content: Schedule a 20-minute call with a sales consultant. We will walk through your brand, your timeline, and your in-house design capacity, and recommend the path that gets you to launch fastest.
params.headline: Not sure which path is right for you?

params.title: Fill Out the Form to Talk to A Consultant

items.answer: Yes. You own the design files for your labels, including print-ready PDFs and the original source files (Adobe Illustrator). You can take them to another supplier if you ever choose to, although we hope you don't.
items.question: Do I get to keep the label design files?

items.answer: Bring it. Our team will apply your existing brand identity (logo, colors, typography) to label designs. This is faster than starting from scratch and usually produces stronger results because your brand identity is consistent across all customer touchpoints.
items.question: What if I already have a brand identity and want it applied to labels?

items.answer: Yes. We accept customer-supplied artwork as long as it meets our technical requirements (vector files, CMYK color profile, correct bleed and trim). See the Customer-Supplied Artwork page for full specs. Most clients find it easier to use our in-house team since we know our packaging and printing constraints intimately.
items.question: Can I use my own designer instead?

items.answer: It is genuinely included for private label engagements. There are no surprise design fees. We charge separately for custom formulation projects (because R&D is real work), but label design for private label is part of the package.
items.question: Is design really included or do you upsell it later?

items.answer: We offer fully custom design beyond the template library for clients who want a more distinctive look. Custom design takes longer and may incur additional cost depending on scope. Many clients combine: start from a template, then customize heavily.
